text_block_list.text:
Today is the Tenno Sho (Autumn). Tosen 
Jordan, who shares a history with Gold 
Ship, is also running.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"What we're making today is...! A shocking 
surprise!! Sea urchin stuffed inside 
chestnut burrs☆"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Similar on the outside, but totally 
different inside☆ Be sure to give your 
opponents a big surprise on the turf, 
everyone~☆

Today as well, Gold Ship is displaying her 
own unique fighting spirit, but—

Does she even remember her match with 
Tosen Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Hm? What do you want? Looking to catch a 
Chestnut Knuckle to the face?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, today's that day?! The big one?! It 
totally, completely slipped my mind!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Is it legal to throw chestnut burrs at 
your opponents during a race?

I decided to confiscate all the chestnut 
burrs Gold Ship was holding...!!
